dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you have on offer?

dialogues.speaker: Khalid
dialogues.text: All the jewels we currently have for sale have already been reserved.

dialogues.speaker: Khalid
dialogues.text: You mean what we have in the shop? Most are from my personal collection and are just for display.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you have on offer?

dialogues.speaker: Khalid
dialogues.text: We'll occasionally deal in merchandise other than jewelry. Be my guest.

dialogues.speaker: Khalid
dialogues.text: I'm an antique collector, and I sell jewelry here and there.

dialogues.speaker: Khalid
dialogues.text: Precious antiques are worth treasuring, and their prices are also out of the budgets of ordinary people, so it's not about making sales for me.

dialogues.speaker: Khalid
dialogues.text: What I do care about is whether I can get more vendors as discerning as Lord Sangemah Bay to supply me with the most valuable collectors' items.

dialogues.speaker: Khalid
dialogues.text: ...That is to say, trading is more like my side business.

dialogues.speaker: Khalid
dialogues.text: As for my main business... I suppose that would be to raise my son into a collector with taste as astute as my own.

dialogues.speaker: Khalid
dialogues.text: Feresht is a gifted child. I'm certain he can become an even more renowned antiques appraisal expert than me.
